gloss: to get drunk; to get intoxicated; to get motion sick

definitions.gloss: to get drunk; to become intoxicated
definitions.explanation: To become affected by alcohol. Describes the state of being under the influence of alcoholic drinks.

definitions.gloss: to get motion sick; to feel nauseous from motion
definitions.explanation: To feel sick from the rocking or movement of a vehicle, boat, or other transport.

definitions.gloss: to be intoxicated; to be entranced
definitions.explanation: To be deeply absorbed or captivated by something beautiful, exciting, or pleasurable. A figurative extension of the intoxication meaning.

notes:
Godan verb. Conjugates as {酔|よ}う・{酔|よ}って・{酔|よ}った. The particle ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ marks the cause of intoxication or motion sickness.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦お{酒|さけ}→お酒：01045_osake⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{酔|よ}う (to get drunk on alcohol)
- ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{酔|よ}う (to get carsick)
- ⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{酔|よ}う (to get seasick)
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{酔|よ}いしれる (to be intoxicated/entranced by ~)
- {酔|よ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧ (the alcohol goes to one's head)
- {酔|よ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{覚|さ}める→覚める：02058_sameru⟧ (to sober up)

The te-form {酔|よ}って is often used as an adjective meaning "drunk." The related noun {酔|よ}い means "drunkenness" or "intoxication." For motion sickness, ～{酔|よ}い forms compounds: ⟦{車酔|くるまよ}い→車酔い：14733_kurumayoi⟧ (carsickness), ⟦{船酔|ふなよ}い→船酔い：30619_funayoi⟧ (seasickness).
